title: TruthWeaver rule tree
description: The flat, key-discriminated JSON tree shape for a TruthWeaver rule expression, as defined by ADR-0003 (docs/adr/0003-rule-syntax-and-serialization.md). A node is discriminated by which of 'const', 'predicate', or 'op' is present. Constants and operator names are case-insensitive when parsed; a constant may be the string 'unknown'. This schema describes structural JSON shape only, matching what JsonTreeParser accepts before compile-time validation (e.g. XOR/XNOR/IMPLIES binary-only, ExactlyOne/threshold k-range checks) runs; a document can be schema-valid and still fail RuleCompiler validation.

node.description: Any tree node: a constant, a predicate term, or an operator node.

constNode.description: The K3 constant leaf: a JSON boolean (true/false), or a case-insensitive string naming a K3 value. 'unknown' is the only way to write the Unknown constant.

literal.description: An argument literal value: string, number (long or decimal), boolean, or an array of literals. Guid and DateTimeOffset values are written as strings.

predicateNode.description: A term: a predicate bound to named argument literals.

operatorNode.description: An operator node: a unary operator (NOT or an inspection), an n-ary boolean operator, an n-ary threshold operator, BETWEEN or Project.

unaryOperatorNode.description: NOT, or an inspection (IsTrue, IsFalse, IsUnknown, IsKnown; case-insensitive on read): exactly one operand. An inspection always yields a definite true or false.

naryOperatorNode.description: AND, OR, XOR, EQUIVALENT, IMPLIES, NAND, NOR, NXOR, ANY, ALL, NONE, COALESCE, If, ExactlyOne: an operand list ('iff' and the legacy 'xnor' are accepted aliases of 'equivalent'; XOR/EQUIVALENT/IMPLIES/NAND/NOR are compile-time restricted to exactly two operands, IMPLIES as [antecedent, consequent]; that restriction is not expressible as JSON structure; COALESCE takes its operands in priority order; If is compile-time restricted to exactly three operands, [condition, whenTrue, whenFalse]).

thresholdOperatorNode.description: The count-threshold family: AtLeast/AtMost/GreaterThan/LessThan/Exactly, each carrying its threshold as 'k'.

betweenOperatorNode.description: BETWEEN: the number of true operands lies in the inclusive range [min, max]. The bounds' range (0 <= min <= max <= operand count, not the full range) is a compile-time check, not expressible as JSON structure.

projectOperatorNode.description: Project: keeps a true or false operand and replaces unknown with 'unknownAs' (a JSON boolean, or the string "true"/"false" in any letter case on read; unknown is not allowed). Exactly one operand (compile-time checked). The result is always definite.
